# OTRACE

OTRACE is a clothing label that sells two in-stock heavyweight fleece pieces: an Oversized Hoodie and a Wide-Leg Sweatpant, garment dyed in Onyx Black and Warm Cream.

## Products

### Oversized Hoodie
- Price: 148 USD
- Fabric: 450 GSM heavyweight cotton fleece, brushed on the inside, pre-shrunk, garment dyed after sewing
- Fit: boxy and oversized, dropped shoulder. Take your usual size for the oversized fit, or size down for a cleaner line. Cut about a full size large on purpose.
- Details: self-lined double-layer hood, split kangaroo pocket, metal drawcord tips through metal eyelets, ribbed cuffs and hem, OTRACE wordmark embroidered at the chest
- Colorways: Onyx Black, Warm Cream
- Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL
- Availability: in stock
- URL: https://otrace.co/product/oversized-hoodie

### Wide-Leg Sweatpant
- Price: 128 USD
- Fabric: the same 450 GSM heavyweight cotton fleece, pre-shrunk, garment dyed after sewing
- Fit: relaxed wide leg, true to size at the waist, ribbed ankle cuff that stacks
- Details: drawcord waist with metal tips, side seam pockets, OTRACE monogram embroidered at the thigh
- Colorways: Onyx Black, Warm Cream
- Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL
- Availability: in stock
- URL: https://otrace.co/product/wide-leg-sweatpant

## Sizing

Measurements are the garment laid flat, in centimetres. Inches are that centimetre figure divided by 2.54 and rounded to 0.1. The same numbers are on https://otrace.co/sizing.

Hoodie — Chest: XS 40 cm (15.7 in), S 44 cm (17.3 in), M 48 cm (18.9 in), L not published, XL 50 cm (19.7 in), 2XL 53 cm (20.9 in), 3XL 54 cm (21.3 in)
Hoodie — Body length: XS 62 cm (24.4 in), S 64 cm (25.2 in), M 68 cm (26.8 in), L not published, XL 70 cm (27.6 in), 2XL 72 cm (28.3 in), 3XL 74 cm (29.1 in)
Hoodie — Shoulder: XS 15 cm (5.9 in), S 16 cm (6.3 in), M 17 cm (6.7 in), L 18 cm (7.1 in), XL 19 cm (7.5 in), 2XL 20 cm (7.9 in), 3XL 21 cm (8.3 in)

Sweatpant — Outseam: XS 76 cm (29.9 in), S 78 cm (30.7 in), M 80 cm (31.5 in), L 80 cm (31.5 in), XL 82 cm (32.3 in), 2XL 84 cm (33.1 in), 3XL 86 cm (33.9 in)
Sweatpant — Inseam: XS 76 cm (29.9 in), S 77 cm (30.3 in), M not published, L 75 cm (29.5 in), XL 77 cm (30.3 in), 2XL 78 cm (30.7 in), 3XL 79 cm (31.1 in)
Sweatpant — Leg opening: XS 10 cm (3.9 in), S 11 cm (4.3 in), M 12 cm (4.7 in), L 13 cm (5.1 in), XL 14 cm (5.5 in), 2XL 15 cm (5.9 in), 3XL 16 cm (6.3 in)

Size L chest, size L body length, and size M inseam are not published. On the factory sheet those cells were smaller than the size below them.

The spec sheet also has a row labeled "Sleeve / waist". Those cells are XS 26 cm (10.2 in), S 27 cm (10.6 in), M 28 cm (11.0 in), L 29 cm (11.4 in), XL 30 cm (11.8 in), 2XL 34 cm (13.4 in), 3XL 35 cm (13.8 in). The sheet does not say whether the row is a sleeve or a waist, so it is not described as either.

## Shipping
- Destination: United States only for AW2026. International is planned for a later drop.
- Cost: free on every order
- Time: in-stock orders ship within 3–5 business days
- Tracking: emailed when the parcel leaves

## Returns
- Window: 30 days from delivery
- Condition: unworn, tags attached
- Method: email OTRACE and a label is sent
- Refund: original payment method, within 5–10 business days of the parcel reaching OTRACE
- Faulty or wrong item: tell OTRACE within 30 days; return shipping is covered

## FAQ

Do heavyweight hoodies shrink?
OTRACE heavyweight hoodies are pre-shrunk 450 GSM cotton fleece. Wash them cold and tumble dry low. High heat is what shrinks cotton hoodies.

What is 450 GSM hoodie?
A 450 GSM hoodie is cotton fleece weighing 450 grams per square metre. The OTRACE Oversized Hoodie is that weight: heavyweight loopback fleece, brushed on the inside, garment dyed.

Are hoodies unisex?
Yes. OTRACE hoodies are unisex, sized XS to 3XL. Take your usual size for the oversized fit, or size down for a cleaner line.

Boxy hoodie meaning
A boxy hoodie is cut square through the body with a dropped shoulder, not tapered at the waist. The OTRACE Oversized Hoodie is cut that way.

Do sweatpants shrink in the dryer?
These sweatpants are pre-shrunk 450 GSM cotton fleece. Tumble dry low. High heat is what shrinks cotton sweatpants in the dryer.

450 GSM sweatpants
450 GSM sweatpants are heavyweight cotton fleece at 450 grams per square metre. The OTRACE Wide-Leg Sweatpant is that fleece, garment dyed, cut wide, with a ribbed ankle.

What does garment dyed mean?
Garment dyed means the piece is sewn first and dyed afterwards, so the colour settles into the seams. OTRACE hoodies and sweatpants are garment dyed 450 GSM cotton fleece in Onyx Black and Warm Cream.

Garment dyed vs piece dyed
Piece dyed means the fabric is dyed before it is cut and sewn. Garment dyed means the finished piece is dyed after sewing, so seams and body take the dye together. OTRACE is garment dyed, and small variation between pieces is normal.

Does garment dye fade?
Garment dye softens with wear rather than fading out. OTRACE dyes the hoodie and sweatpant after sewing. Wash cold, inside out, and tumble dry low.

How should an oversized hoodie fit?
An oversized hoodie should sit roomy through the body, with a dropped shoulder, longer than a standard fit. Take your usual size for that look, or size down for a cleaner line. This hoodie is cut a full size large on purpose.

Oversized hoodie size chart
Chest, body length and shoulder are garment-flat centimetres. XS chest is 40 cm, which is 15.7 inches. Take your usual size for the oversized fit, or size down for a cleaner line.

Wide leg sweatpants size chart
Outseam, inseam and leg opening are garment-flat centimetres. The waist is true to size and the leg is cut wide with a ribbed ankle. XS outseam is 76 cm, or 29.9 inches.

Unisex hoodies size chart
OTRACE hoodies are unisex, XS to 3XL. This size chart is the same garment-flat measurement for every body. Take your usual size for the oversized fit.

What is your return policy?
Unworn items with tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund or an exchange. Email us and we send a label. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of the parcel reaching us.
